nodes.description: EIP-1967 implementation storage slot 0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc, read/written via assembly sload/sstore in Proxy.
EIP-173 admin/owner storage slot 0xb53127684a568b3173ae13b9f8a6016e243e63b6e8ee1178d6a717850b5d6103, read/written via assembly sload/sstore in EIP173Proxy.
EIP173Proxy constructor(address implementationAddress, address ownerAddress, bytes data) payable: sets implementation then owner.
External view owner(): returns _owner() (admin address from EIP-173 slot).
External supportsInterface(bytes4 id): ERC-165 detection that forwards the call to the implementation via try/catch.
External transferOwnership(address newOwner) onlyOwner: writes the new owner to the admin slot.
External upgradeTo(address newImplementation) onlyOwner: updates the implementation slot with empty init data.
External payable upgradeToAndCall(address newImplementation, bytes data) onlyOwner: updates the implementation and delegatecalls the init data.
onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == _owner(), 'NOT_AUTHORIZED'), the sole access-control gate of the proxy.
Internal view _owner(): assembly sload of the EIP-173 owner slot, returns adminAddress.
Internal _setOwner(address newOwner): reads previous owner, sstores the new owner and emits OwnershipTransferred.
receive() external payable virtual: explicitly reverts with ETHER_REJECTED by default.
fallback() external payable: routes all unknown calldata into _fallback() for delegatecall to the implementation.
Internal _fallback(): loads implementation address from slot, calldatacopy then delegatecall and returns/reverts with returned data.
Internal _setImplementation(address newImplementation, bytes data): writes implementation slot, emits event and optionally delegatecalls init data.
msg.sender: untrusted caller identity compared against the stored owner in the onlyOwner modifier.
Low-level delegatecall to the implementation inside _fallback(): executes arbitrary implementation code in proxy storage context.
Low-level delegatecall(newImplementation, data) inside _setImplementation(): runs attacker-supplied init data in the proxy context.
Raw assembly sstore into the EIP-173 owner slot, bypassing all language level checks.
Raw assembly sstore into the EIP-1967 implementation slot, bypassing all language level checks.
Parameter newOwner of external transferOwnership(address newOwner).
Parameter bytes4 id of supportsInterface(bytes4 id), forwarded to the implementation.
Parameter newImplementation of upgradeTo(address newImplementation).
Parameter newImplementation of upgradeToAndCall(address newImplementation, bytes data).
Parameter data of upgradeToAndCall(address newImplementation, bytes data), forwarded as init data to the delegatecall.
Parameter newImplementation of internal _setImplementation(address newImplementation, bytes data).
Parameter data of internal _setImplementation(address newImplementation, bytes data), used as delegatecall payload.
Constructor parameter implementationAddress of EIP173Proxy.
Constructor parameter ownerAddress of EIP173Proxy.
Constructor parameter data of EIP173Proxy, passed through to _setImplementation.
Local ERC165 implementation address loaded from the implementation slot inside supportsInterface.
Local adminAddress returned by _owner() from the assembly sload of the owner slot.
Local previousOwner captured in _setOwner() before overwriting the owner slot.
Local previousImplementation captured in _setImplementation() before overwriting the implementation slot.

edges.reason: Constructor argument implementationAddress is forwarded to _setImplementation, which stores it as the delegatecall target.
Constructor init data is passed to _setImplementation and may be delegatecalled during deployment.
Constructor argument ownerAddress is written into the owner slot through _setOwner.
Untrusted new owner supplied by the caller flows into _setOwner and rewrites privileged ownership state.
transferOwnership delegates the ownership change to the internal _setOwner after modifier checks.
upgradeTo's newImplementation argument flows into _setImplementation.
upgradeToAndCall's newImplementation argument flows into _setImplementation.
upgradeToAndCall's calldata bytes are forwarded to _setImplementation as delegatecall payload.
The attacker-controlled/owner-controlled newImplementation is written into the implementation slot, becoming the target of future delegatecalls.
Init data is executed via delegatecall inside _setImplementation, giving the new implementation arbitrary code execution before state changes settle.
msg.sender is the untrusted value enforced by the onlyOwner require check.
onlyOwner gates transferOwnership; failure of the check reverts the call.
onlyOwner gates upgradeTo, protecting the implementation slot from unauthorised upgrades.
onlyOwner gates upgradeToAndCall, the most dangerous privileged entrypoint (upgrade plus delegatecall).
The stored owner returned by _owner() is the reference value compared against msg.sender in the modifier.
The constructor calls _setImplementation to initialise the EIP-1967 slot.
The constructor calls _setOwner to initialise the privileged owner slot.
fallback() forwards every unmatched call to the internal _fallback routine.
_fallback performs a low-level delegatecall to the implementation, so all proxy state is exposed to implementation code and reentrant entrypoints.
_setImplementation conditionally delegatecalls the supplied init data, allowing reentrant manipulation of proxy storage.
_setImplementation writes the new implementation address to the EIP-1967 slot.
_setOwner performs the raw sstore that overwrites the owner slot.
_setOwner reads the current owner through _owner() before transferring ownership.
owner() returns the value produced by the internal _owner() storage read.
The implementation slot value is loaded in _fallback and used directly as the delegatecall target.
The raw sstore commits a new value to the implementation slot that later controls every delegatecall.
The raw sstore commits a new privileged owner into the EIP-173 admin slot.
_owner() reads the admin slot that defines the access-control authority of the proxy.
supportsInterface performs an external call to the implementation address within a try/catch block.
The interface id parameter is forwarded to the implementation's supportsInterface external call.
adminAddress is the local value returned by the assembly sload inside _owner().
previousOwner is the local snapshot read at the start of _setOwner() and emitted in OwnershipTransferred.
previousImplementation is the local snapshot of the implementation slot read before the sstore in _setImplementation.
_setImplementation loads the current implementation slot to emit ProxyImplementationUpdated.

normalization_plan.reason: The ephemeral newOwner parameter has no independent semantic identity; its only meaning is as the argument of transferOwnership.
The bytes4 id parameter is a plain selector argument that only exists within supportsInterface.
The newImplementation argument belongs exclusively to the upgradeTo entrypoint.
The newImplementation argument belongs exclusively to upgradeToAndCall.
The init data argument is only meaningful as the payload of upgradeToAndCall.
The internal newImplementation parameter is fully absorbed by _setImplementation.
The data parameter exists only to feed the delegatecall performed by _setImplementation, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
Deployment-only argument with no runtime identity outside the constructor.
Deployment-only argument with no runtime identity outside the constructor.
Deployment-only init data that is consumed during construction.
The local ERC165 handle is a temporary alias produced and consumed inside supportsInterface.
adminAddress is the direct return value of the assembly read in _owner().
previousOwner is a transient snapshot used only for the event emitted by _setOwner.
previousImplementation is a transient snapshot used only for the event emitted by _setImplementation.
